messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Disconnect from server (turning grey) when deployment
parts:
Your instance is running out of memory and is being killed.
Try a larger instance size or a way of altering your code to make more efficient use of the memory available.

Sorry this is not surfaced better, it is something we intend to improve.
